title: Embed a local LLM for NPC dialog and decision making, runs in browser with 3x performance over Transformers.js
author: lordhiggsboson
selftext:
Fully open-source: [https://github.com/noumena-labs/Sipp](https://github.com/noumena-labs/Sipp)

\-- Documentation is built for Codex/Claude Code. 

\-- Source code for vision, AI avatars, and multi-agent demos: [https://github.com/noumena-labs/Sipp/tree/master/demos](https://github.com/noumena-labs/Sipp/tree/master/demos)

comments.author: oVerde
comments.body: I’m on the make of a similar tech stack for my game

replies.author: lordhiggsboson
replies.body: nice, the project is under apache 2.0, which is as permissive as it gets. and allows anyone to fork, use, steal, etc. anything in the code base

replies.author: oVerde
replies.body: Absolutely going to take a look at what was your strategy onto communicating with the LLM

replies.author: lordhiggsboson
replies.body: the library is mostly agnostic to how communication works atm. It has raw query, and chat (system, user, assistant) interfaces. But the NPM package is bundled with some light-weight harnesses for creating characters and directors that enable creating NPCs via a json config: [https://github.com/noumena-labs/Sipp/blob/03e50b3f922bb2fe51b1abe0f370ac79801538f4/demos/avatar/src/App.tsx#L171](https://github.com/noumena-labs/Sipp/blob/03e50b3f922bb2fe51b1abe0f370ac79801538f4/demos/avatar/src/App.tsx#L171)
